title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is The Carpenters’ “We’ve Only Just Begun” — a tender soft-rock classic with a warm, wedding-day glow and an easy sway. It gives Djembe a graceful romantic feature moment for the room: familiar, heartfelt, and gentle enough to let the lyric and vocal carry the emotion.
songListNote: The Carpenters’ tender soft-rock classic — a warm, romantic slow-sway feature joining the show rotation.
